## Organizations

* CRKN
* Digital Research Alliance of Canada
* DataCite Canada Consortium
* Borealis
* CrossRef
* LAC
* CPIDAC
* Statistics Canada: national statistical office, collection data, analyzing, and publishing statisitcal data about Canadian society. For me, Data from Canadian Health Survey on Children and Youth looks interesting
(source: https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/start)

## Persistent Identifiers

* PID
* ORCID
* DOI
* ISSN

## Concepts
* Open Access
* Open Source
* Metadata
* License (as a verb, providing access to ejournals, databases, etc)
* Creative Commons License
* Trustworthy Digital Repository (TDR)
* COUNTER usage statistics
* Peer review
* SAFES Data
* FAIR Principles
* CARE Principles
* Microdata: individual data/response from survey before statistical analysis. each of them represents individuals that answered survey (source:https://guides.library.ubc.ca/datastatistics/microdata )
